schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: One machine's GPUs and host RAM, from what its node last pushed (default: the console's own machine).
Plain-language help for every parameter, metric, state and term (learn mode), for the registered engines.

schema.title: Response Engines Api V1 Engines Get

get.description: The parameter catalogue with each parameter's plain-language `explain` and its `level` filled in.

schema.title: Response Engine Params Api V1 Engines  Engine  Params Get

post.description:
Download a Hugging Face repository (or some of its files, `allow_patterns`) into a writable model root of any
machine: `host_id` and `root_id` (default: that machine's first writable Hugging Face root).

get.description: SSE: a snapshot of every download, then live progress. `once=true` ends after the snapshot.

schema.title: Response Stream Downloads Api V1 Downloads Stream Get

get.description:
The v1 shape, kept: the Hugging Face models of every machine, each with its `host_id` (`GET /library` is the
full picture). `engines_that_fit` is judged against that machine's own GPUs.

delete.description:
Remove a model from this machine's Hugging Face cache (the library's delete, with its checks: not while an engine
uses it, and only where the node's policy allows deletes). Other machines' copies are not touched.

get.description:
Every model on every machine, grouped by model. `host` keeps the models that machine holds or can load from
shared storage. A machine that is down shows its last-known models, with a warning.

post.description:
Ask the nodes to rescan their model roots now. The answer is the machines asked; changes arrive through the
library as each scan finishes.

schema.title: Response Rescan Library Api V1 Library Rescan Post

delete.description:
Delete one copy from its machine. 409 while an engine uses it, 403 when that machine's node policy forbids
deletes or the root is read-only, 503 when the machine is down.

post.description: Copy a model to another machine (or another drive of the same one): a download row of kind "copy".

get.description: Managed, script and external instances of every machine (or one: `?host=`).

post.description: Dry run of the checks POST /instances performs (additive to the contract).

Re-read every node's inventory. Nodes push it on change (at least every 30 s), so this is a fresh read of what
they last said, not a probe: engines the console did not create show up as soon as a node reports them.

post.description: Body is YAML text (yaml content-type) or JSON {"yaml": "..."}; size-capped by the security middleware.

get.description: Host RAM / shared memory / swap series of one machine (default: the console's own).

post.description:
OpenAI-shaped body plus `instance_id` (required) and optional `conversation_id`. SSE passthrough when stream=true.
Each streamed reply holds an engine request open: at most MAX_CHAT_STREAMS at once, MAX_CHAT_STREAMS_PER_KEY of them
for one key (429 too_many_chat_streams).

put.description:
`host_image_pins` is {host id: {engine id: image}} and replaces the whole table (send {} to clear it). Only the
shape and the pinned-tag rule are checked here; whether a machine may run an image is its own node policy's call,
and the launch checks it.

schema.title: Response Put Settings Api V1 Settings Put
Response List Keys Api V1 Keys Get

post.description: The plaintext `secret` is returned exactly once, here.

schema.title: Response Fleet Stream Api V1 Fleet Stream Get

post.description:
Start one action of a script. The script, the action and the one optional argument are checked against the policy
the node reported; the node checks them again against its own.

get.description: SSE: every output line as event `line` (the whole history first, then live), then one `end` with the job.

schema.title: Response Job Stream Api V1 Scripts Jobs  Job Id  Stream Get

Explain.title: Explain
Explain.description:
Plain-language help for one parameter, metric or concept ("learn mode", contract v2). Written for someone
who has never run an inference engine. Authored in learn/*.json, never in code; see learn/README.md.

GgufGroup.title: GgufGroup
GgufGroup.description: The .gguf files of one quantisation of a repo: one file, or every shard of a split set.

HostMemInfo.title: HostMemInfo
HostMemInfo.description: Host RAM/swap from /proc/meminfo, in GiB. used = total - available.

HostMemory.title: HostMemory
HostMemory.description: Host RAM held by one container. cgroup v2 `file` includes shmem, so cache = file - shmem: no double count.

InstanceControls.title: InstanceControls
InstanceControls.description: What the UI may offer for one instance; `reason` says why something is not offered.

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: Facts about a HF model needed for fit estimation + compatibility rules (built by core from the HF API).

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description: What to load, on the host chosen for the instance. Exactly the fields of its format are used.

ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec
ParamSpec.description: One tunable engine parameter, described enough to render a form + validate + emit a CLI flag.

PolicyFacts.title: PolicyFacts
PolicyFacts.description: The node's own local policy, as it reported it. The hub can read it, never change it.

RootInfo.title: RootInfo
RootInfo.description: A model root from the node policy, plus where it physically lives.

ScriptInfo.title: ScriptInfo
ScriptInfo.description: A lifecycle script registered in a node's policy (e.g. a lab's own start/stop script for an engine).
